title: Comparison of two analgetic-regiments in neurosurgical spinal fusions and the effect of these on the postoperative opioid consumption
summary: In this study we are evaluating two different types of pain treatments in neurosurgical spinal fusions in adult patients. Patients receive either only analgetics through the vein, or they also receive a singleshot of an analgetic into the spinal column through the surgeon.

interventions.name: intravenous analgesia with an intrathecal singleshot

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. given written informed consent
2. elective dorsal spinal fusion at th10 and downwards, maximum of 3 levels
3. age >18 years
Exclusion criteria:
1. No written informed consent
2. Age <18years
3. Participation in an other prospective study within the last 30 days
4. Opioids >3 weeks and >70 mg oral morphin äquivalent
5. no german speakers
6. not able to give informed consent
7. not allowing the saving and using of personal, medical data
